Finally! Now I've got a permanent job.
sentences.En venn av meg jobber i et transportbyrå: A friend of mine works at a transport company, and they needed people.
I had an interview last week.
sentences.Så flott! Hva slags jobb er det?: How great! What kind of job is it?
I'm going to be a driver's mate on a lorry.
sentences.Vi leverer vaskemaskiner og komfyrer og: We deliver washing machines and cookers and things like that to people's homes.
sentences.Jo, det er en ganske tung jobb, men jeg: Yes, it's quite a heavy job, but I get a good workout!
sentences.Det verste er at vi begynner så tidlig o: The worst thing is that we start so early in the morning.
I have to be at work at seven o'clock.
That's when we start loading the lorry.
sentences.Men hvordan går det med deg, da?: But how are things with you, then?
sentences.Jeg har søkt mange jobber uten å få svar: I've applied for lots of jobs without getting any answer.
Yes, I know what it's like.
sentences.Men nå har jeg kontakt med et vikarbyrå: But now I'm in touch with a temp agency here in town.
sentences.De har fått cv-en min, og i neste uke sk: They've got my CV, and next week I'm going for an interview.
sentences.Det er bra. Jeg har hørt at mange får jo: That's good. I've heard that lots of people get jobs through temp agencies.
sentences.Jeg håper det blir slik for meg også. Nå: I hope it'll be like that for me too. I really need to get a job now.
